jcr_content.jcr:title: i-Chips IP00C814 - Video Processor with 4K Input & Output
jcr_content.jcr:description: Upgrade to the i-Chips IP00C814, a 4K video processor featuring dual input & PiP support, integrated scalers, & warping. It is ideal for multi-screen setups.
jcr_content.keywords: IP00C814, image processing LSI, scaler, de-interlace, warping engine, 4K input, 4K output, multi-functional, embedded CPU, JPEG codec, HDMI Rx, high-speed ADC, video decoder, LVDS, V-by-One® Tx, HDR, 3DLUT, color management, edge-blending, multi-screen systems, projectors.

textwithimage_1.text: The IP00C814 is an enhanced multi-functional image processing LSI with integrated 2-channel scaler and de-interlace cores as well as a 1-channel warping engine. This video processor can accept 4K dual input images with 2K PiP/PoP output images and a single 4K input image with a 4K output image. This device has an embedded CPU, and peripherals such as JPEG codec, HDMI Rx, high-speed ADC, video decoder, and LVDS/V-by-One® Tx. In addition, high-performance functions such as HDR, 3DLUT for color management, and edge-blending required for multi-screen systems with multiple projectors are also integrated.

text_1.text:
Image input (2 systems)

  • RGB 30bit / YUV4:4:4 30bit/ YUV4:2:2 20bit/ YUV4:2:2 10bit/YUV4:2:0 30bit
  • HDMI x2 / LV-CMOS x2 / Analog RGB / CVBS

Image output (2 lines)

  • RGB 30bit / YUV4:4:4 30bit / YUV4:2:2 20bit / YUV4:2:2 10bit / YUV4:2:0 / 30bit
  • LVDS (2-phase output) x2 / V-by-One® HS

Input/output image size

  • Horizontal sync signal interval: 16,384 pixels
  • Horizontal image effective area: 2,176 pixels

External DDR3-SDRAM

  • Scaler image memory: 32bit PC1600 (4G/2G/1Gx16) x2
  • Arm® main memory: 16bit PC1600 (4G/2G/1Gx16) x1

External/internal synchronization

  • Output sync signal only supports internal sync signal

I/O synchronous/asynchronous operation

  • Frame rate conversion
  • Overtaking control
  • External forced synchronization
  • Genlock

Built-in HDMI Rx

  • HDMI2.0b and HDCP2.3 compatible (DVI1.0 compatible)
  • Built-in HDCP Key
  • Audio Interface Supports L-PCM and Compressed Audio Data

Built-in high-speed AD converter

  • Maximum operating frequency 165MHz
  • Hsync/Vsync separate input support
  • Supports clock phase adjustment (32 steps)
  • Supports Sync on Green input

Built-in video decoder

  • NTSC-M, JPN, 4.43/ PAL-B, D, G, H, I, N, M, Combination N, 60/ SECAM compatible
  • VBI (Closed Caption/CGMS/WSS) data extraction function
  • Supports clamp pulse output

Built-in CPU

  • Arm Cortex®-A9 (660MHz)
  • Cache L1: Instruction 32KB Data 32KB L2: 128KB
  • Boot device Serial flash/eMMC/EEPROM (I2C Ch4) selectable
  • Work RAM (128KB)
  • 8-bit parallel/4-wire serial for external CPU

CPU peripheral function

  • Ethernet (10/100/1000Mbps)
  • USB2.0 (Host/Device 2ch)
  • SD Card/eMMC
  • JPEG codec
  • DMA (8ch)/UART (5ch)/I2C (4ch)/Timer (4ch)/IR remote controller (3ch)/10bitADC (8ch,MUX)/10bitDAC (3ch)

External interface

  • External interrupt (4 lines)
  • Serial flash interface

Motion adaptive interpolation IP conversion

  • Supports YUV4:2:2
  • Supports multi-cadence
  • Equipped with a high-performance motion detection filter (YUV compatible)

Resolution conversion

  • Expansion/reduction Equipped with 6-symbol interpolation filter
  • Built-in coefficient ROM (64 sets)

Image distortion correction

  • RGB independent image distortion correction
  • Correction coordinate table reference method
  • Built-in correction coordinate table generator (keystone correction, pincushion correction)
  • Loaded from external serial flash or external CPU
  • Horizontal/vertical lines can be corrected up to 45 degrees

Noise reduction

  • 3DNR (H/V/Temporal)
  • MPEG-NR (Mosquito/Block)
  • Chroma bug canceller

Image correction function

  • Edge blending (RGB independent gamma correction, white peaking supported)
  • Up/down/left/right flip
  • 90° rotation
  • Overlay
  • Alpha blend
  • Chroma key

Image quality adjustment function

  • 3DLUT
  • Static HDR (PQ and HLG)/Dynamic HDR (SMPTE2094-10,40)
  • Uniformity correction
  • Horizontal/vertical edge enhancement (9 symbols)
  • 16-bit gamma correction (7 sets can be set)
  • Error diffusion
  • Brightness and contrast correction

Bitmap OSD

  • Supports 256 colors and 64K colors (high color)
  • Font data expansion function (65536 characters)
  • 4 transparent colors, blink function
  • 90° rotation
  • Scroll function
  • Bitmap transfer from serial flash possible

Power supply

  • 3.3V/2.5V/1.5V/1.2V/1.1V power supply

Package

  • 840-pin plastic BGA
  • Ball pitch 0.8mm, 31mm × 31mm
